bizcity_twin_event_stream.purpose: Canonical event bus store for all TwinBrain + TwinCore events (R-EVT-1). One row per event_type emission; immutable append-only log.
bizcity_twin_event_stream.note: Table owned by core/twin-core (class-twin-event-store.php) and declared in core.twin-core.json; kept here as a cross-reference. [2026-09-16 Johnny Chu - Chu Hoàng Anh] PHASE-1.33C C13 — Correct the bizcity_twin_event_stream declaration from 9 columns to the 15 the physical table and BizCity_Twin_Event_Store::persist() actually use (adds conversation_id, session_id, parent_event_id, parent_event_uuid, schema_version, created_epoch_ms; corrects event_uuid to CHAR(36), event_type to VARCHAR(48), payload_json to NOT NULL, created_at to DATETIME(3)) and aligns the index set. No DDL is added here: the physical table was always the 15-column shape built by BizCity_Twin_Event_Stream_Schema::ensure_table(), so this row repairs the DECLARATION, not the database. The mismatch mattered because ensure_table() stamped bizcity_twin_event_stream_db_ver unconditionally after dbDelta, so a tenant whose table predated the newer columns kept a matching version option, short-circuited every later repair and failed every dispatch with "Failed to persist event" — the failure observed on libedemo.bizcity.vn / blog 1511. ensure_table() now verifies the physical column set through BizCity_Table_Metadata before stamping, and DB_VERSION moved 0.12.1 → 0.12.2 to force one repair pass. Repair is additive only; no DROP.
